selected_evidence.summary: FreeRADIUS configuration validation passed, node2 is the configured client, its generated secret is 64 characters, and node2's secret/configuration files are root-only.
Direct tests before and after restarts proved Access-Accept for correct credentials, Access-Reject for an incorrect password, and no acceptance with an incorrect client secret.
